next_cycle_soh.target: next recorded discharge relative SOH percent
next_cycle_soh.cross_battery_comparator: LOBO MAE 0.5924 SOH percentage points; persistence MAE 0.5574

rul.target: remaining recorded discharges until first capacity <= 1.4 Ah
rul.cross_battery_comparator: Exploratory three-cell LOBO; XGBoost pooled MAE 11.67 cycles across three held-out complete cells

Oxford.capacity_reference: capacity from the first measured record supplied by the user
Oxford.sample_weighting: equal total weight per cell, then equal weight per valid record

validation.method: leave-one-cell-out; the reported validation value is from held-out folds, not this final all-cell fit
validation.interpretation: Exploratory cell-held-out result; eight cells, no confidence interval.

CALCE_CS2.capacity_reference: capacity from the first measured record supplied by the user
CALCE_CS2.sample_weighting: equal total weight per cell, then equal weight per valid record

validation.method: leave-one-cell-out; the reported validation value is from held-out folds, not this final all-cell fit
validation.interpretation: Exploratory result is effectively tied with persistence at this precision; six cells, no confidence interval.

source_rul_status.NASA: Existing NASA-specific RUL model only; 1.4 Ah study endpoint.
source_rul_status.Oxford: RUL withheld: only two of eight cells crossed the 70%-of-first-record exploratory endpoint.
source_rul_status.CALCE_CS2: RUL withheld in the interactive analyzer; cross-family RUL validation was not reliable enough for transfer.

limitations: Models are selected and fitted for their named source family; no cross-family generalization is claimed.
Oxford and CALCE SOH use a harmonized four-feature model and the user-provided first-measurement reference capacity.
CALCE validation is effectively tied with persistence and should be treated as a research comparison, not a demonstrated improvement.
RUL and second-life advice are not available for Oxford or CALCE in this release.
Laboratory-cell evidence does not establish EV pack or field validation.
